The selected machine's states as blocks. Click to select, double-click (or Enter) a transition to go to its state or a call to go to its machine, Backspace to go back. Up/Down step through the blocks.
Back to where the last transition or call was followed from (Backspace).
How many call blocks in this file start this machine. Properties lists the machines they're in.
States no transition of this machine leads to (state 0, where the machine starts, isn't counted). Vanilla files have these too.
